groups.title: Express core: app factory, application settings, request/response helpers, view lookup

risks.text: Request and response helpers are prototypes mixed onto each app; app.request/app.response get a per-app `app` property, so helpers must reach settings through this.app, not globals
Proxy-derived request values (protocol, ip, hostname) are only honoured when the 'trust proxy fn' setting trusts the socket address; changing trust handling can allow header spoofing
Sub-app mounting deletes the child's default trust proxy settings so it inherits from the parent; this depends on a hidden symbol flag
res.sendFile throws unless the path is absolute or opts.root is given, and dotfiles are denied by default; relaxing this exposes files from user-supplied paths
Redirect/Location values go through encodeUrl and escapeHtml (for the HTML body); bypassing them opens header or XSS injection

groups.title: Mocha test suite and acceptance tests that exercise lib/ and examples/

risks.text: Tests run with --check-leaks, so any accidental global variable fails the run
test/support/env.js sets NODE_ENV=test and silences express/body-parser deprecations; it must be required or settings like view cache and logging change
test/acceptance/ runs the examples through the real app, so editing an example can break npm test

groups.title: Runnable sample apps, one folder each, indexed in examples/README.md

risks.text: Each example is exercised by test/acceptance, so changing its routes or output breaks tests
Examples are listed in examples/README.md; keep the index in step when adding or removing one

groups.title: CI, CodeQL, scorecard, legacy and npm publish workflows plus dependabot

risks.text: ci.yml tests Node 18-26 on Linux and Windows, so path handling must work on both
Actions are pinned to commit SHAs with read-only permissions; keep pins when updating

groups.title: Package manifest, lint and npm config, docs and licence

risks.text: .npmrc sets ignore-scripts, a 7-day min-release-age and no lockfile (package-lock=false); installs are intentionally unlocked and script-free
package.json scripts are the only entry points for lint and tests; CI calls npm run lint and npm run test-ci

rules.rule: Never read X-Forwarded-* headers without checking the trust proxy function.
res.sendFile must keep rejecting relative paths without a root option.
Location headers must pass through encodeUrl and HTML bodies through escapeHtml.
Code must keep working on every Node.js version allowed by engines (>= 18).
